title: Como o bot decide o que fazer
concept: Blueprint decision ladder from the 21/02/2026 changelog: a decision token drops from the robot's eye down a rail and lights each priority in order (loot → catch → tall grass → bush, madeira e minério → headbutt → andar a rota), then two engineering notes land (detects the char's speed, considers ping) and the close: all of it without touching the mouse.
